title: leucas hirta
intro: Leucas hirta, commonly known as "Hairy Leucas" or "Indian Sage", is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae, native to tropical regions of India and Southeast Asia. The plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties. Leucas hirta's therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-histaminic, and anti-inflammatory activities, which may help in managing conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Leucas hirta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
